messages:
Maya (EventOps): Quick thread to lock the virtual event ops for next Wed10am PT. Topic: "Redwood Optimize deep dive". We need: registration page, region-aware start times, Zoom webinar vs Zoom meeting + YT stream, backup recording, captions, post-event asset plan, and partner promo tracking. Who can take which?

Priya (Growth): I can take registration page on Typeform (faster for design) and wire hidden fields for partner_code + utm_campaign. Also will add timezone dropdown and show regional start times dynamically.

Sam (Prod Marketing): Love Typeform. Landing should include 30s benchmark highlight (to entice). CTA in confirmation: "Watch recording" + "Book demo" buttons. Also we want to gate slides behind email.

Diego (Sales Ops): Routing rules: partner_code present => tag account with partner and route to partner SDR pool. Otherwise, standard routing: if company_headcount >= 100 => AE; else SDR. Add field "interest_band" (low/med/high) based on job_title + answers.

Alice (Content): I'll draft confirmation and three reminders (48h, 2h, 15m). Include calendar attachment with attendee join link. Also include opt-in for marketing emails (GDPR).

Oliver (Design): Ill produce a hero image and two social banners sized for LI/Twitter. Also can provide a branded slide deck template for the presenters.

Maya (EventOps): Zoom details: we have webinar license. Proposal: run as Zoom Webinar to enable Q&A & attendee controls, and use Zoom's Live Stream to YouTube for public viewers. Enable practice session for panelists.

Priya (Growth): Public YouTube stream good for reach. For registrants, we should still deliver unique join link for the Zoom Webinar (so we can track attendance precisely).

Maya (EventOps): Recording plan: enable cloud recording (speaker + gallery) and auto-transcript. In addition request presenters to locally record as backup. After event: marketing team downloads cloud + local, merges if needed, uploads to Vimeo (private) and embeds on blog post.

OtterBot: "Transcription enabled: Otter.ai integration scheduled. Export format: SRT + searchable transcript."

Sam (Prod Marketing): We'll time-stamp highlights and pull 60-90s clips for social. Also create a short blog post with benchmark graph and embedded clip. Alice please include a link to the blog in follow-up.

Diego (Sales Ops): For inbound prioritization: if answer to "Are you evaluating inference infra?" == yes AND company_headcount > 50 => set intent_score high and create AE task. Provide example HubSpot workflow? I can set it up.

Priya (Growth): Tracking: use ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=partner_email&utm_campaign=redwood_optimize_march. In Typeform add hidden fields utm_* and partner_code so our ABM tool gets account-level info.

Alice (Content): Follow-up plan: 1) within 4 hours: recording + slides + transcript + bookmarks of Q&A, 2) 3 days: highlights + CTA to book demo (A/B test subject), 3) 2 weeks: nurture sequence with case study. Two follow-up variants for A/B test: sales-forward vs value-forward.

Oliver (Design): Can we get a slide export template (16:9 PPTX) that includes a slide for TL;DR benchmark and one slide with CTA and book-demo QR code?

Sam (Prod Marketing): Yes please include QR code. We'll also include a shortened demo link with UTM.

Maya (EventOps): Accessibility: auto-captions on Zoom + export SRT from Otter. Also ensure marketing cleans transcript for privacy before publishing.

Priya (Growth): We should also create a partner promo code field and expiration so partners can distribute codes and we can attribute signups. Add validation on Typeform for disposable email blocking (simple domain blacklist).

Diego (Sales Ops): Zapier flow: New Typeform entry -> create/update HubSpot contact -> add contact to webinar list -> if partner_code present -> tag account and notify partner team via webhook. Example filter snippet: 
```
if partner_code != null: webhook POST -> partner-notify-url
else: continue workflow
```

Maya (EventOps): Rehearsal: panelist tech check Tue 30 min before EOD PT (confirm mics, screen-share, slides advance). I'll send panelist instructions: mic/headset, wired ethernet recommended, join 20 mins early.

Sam (Prod Marketing): Panelist lineup: Sam (host), Priya (growth), Dina (Research), Akiko (Platform eng). Akiko please confirm availability. Also include 3 slide backup in case of live demo failure.

Alice (Content): Q&A handling: we'll collect attendee Qs via Zoom Q&A; designate one person to triage and one to read top questions. Also capture unanswered Qs for follow-up FAQ.

Priya (Growth): Partner promo: two partners will co-market. We'll create co-branded social assets and a partner landing query param partner_code=PARTNER1. Diego will route those accounts to partner SDR.

Diego (Sales Ops): I'll set up an automated Slack notify to #sales-inbound when AE-assigned leads come from webinar and company_headcount > 200.

Maya (EventOps): Security note: disable file transfer in chat, restrict recording access to marketing@redwood.com, and set registration to require email verification.

Sam (Prod Marketing): Reminder: record local slides as PDF and upload to GDrive folder: drive.google.com/drive/folders/Marketing/Webinars/Redwood_Optimize_2026. I'll handle upload.

Alice (Content): Post-event: create two email variants for initial send and track open/click rates. We'll tie clickers to demo-booking campaign.

Oliver (Design): I'll drop 3 banner options to the marketing drive by EOD today.

Maya (EventOps): Summary of action owners: Typeform + hidden fields = Priya, Zoom + streaming config = Maya, HubSpot mapping & workflows = Diego, Follow-up emails = Alice, Slide design + social = Oliver, Panelist coordination + slides = Sam. Rehearsal Tue 4:30pm PT. All good?

Priya (Growth): All good from Growth. Adding invite for rehearsal.

Diego (Sales Ops): All set. Will set up webhook and Slack notify.

OtterBot: "Otter integration confirmed. Post-event transcript delivery to marketing@redwood.com."

Maya (EventOps): Great. I'll create Typeform and Zoom invite, then post links here along with rehearsal calendar invite. :thumbsup:
